pipeline: Adventure method and template define the operational grammar: 5W+HOW, agents, conflicts, focal points, acts, scenes, SWADE mechanics, consequences.
Module 1 planning sources define the playable adventure in Markdown.
Foundry JournalEntry JSON exports transpose the planning sources into GM-facing Journal pages.
FQL quests are created from that Journal layer, not from raw prose alone.
Legacy scripts read and update FQL quest flags, generate closeouts and continuity reports, and append controlled GM/Player note blocks.
MasterQuest should turn those scripts into tested module services and a GM control panel.
